primitives.name: Trial-Based Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: Each competitor shall be credited with the best of all his jumps or leaps.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'number of trials', 'B': 'best performance measure', 'P_i': 'performance at trial i'}
primitives.assumptions: Performance is bounded, discrete, and subject to diminishing returns.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T approaches zero or P_i becomes constant.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's maximum likelihood estimation of athlete skill and GSE's policy gradient optimization of trial selection.
layer2.telemetry: Best recorded performance across all trials.

primitives.name: Failure Counting Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: Three balks count as a "try." A competitor may omit his trials at any height, but if he fail at the next height, he shall not be allowed to go back and try the height he omitted.
primitives.assumptions: Failure is cumulative and irreversible once committed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When F ≥ 3 or when a competitor omits a height and fails at the next.

layer2.mapping: Encodes GSI's penalty-weighted loss function and GSE's state transition graph for trial skipping.
layer2.telemetry: Cumulative failure count and trial skipping behavior.

primitives.name: Performance Measurement
primitives.verbatim_quote: The measurement shall be from the outer edge of the joist to the nearest break of the grouud made by any part of his person.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'d_{\\text{outer edge}}': 'distance from outer edge of joist (meters)', 'd_{\\text{nearest break}}': 'distance to nearest ground break (meters)'}
primitives.assumptions: Ground break is measurable and deterministic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When measurement cannot be determined due to ambiguity or surface irregularity.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's distance-based scoring system and GSE's spatial state tracking.
layer2.telemetry: Measured distance from reference point to landing point.
